_purpose: Site-convention hints for the readable web (src/web_reader/parse.rs). The HTML-spec part of readability is fixed in code: script, style, noscript, template, forms, nav, footer, aside and the matching ARIA landmark roles are never content. What differs from site to site is which CLASS or ID marks screen-only chrome, so those live here. Schema: schemas/web_readability.toml. Add a convention when a cooperating site shows clutter; never add a domain, this is about markup conventions, not sites.
